
==Japanese==
'''Ōmiwa Shrine''' (大神神社、おおみわじんじゃ、おおがじんじゃ) refers to Shinto shrines with the name "大神".

==Kantō Region==
* Ōmiwa Shrine (Shimotsuke) (Tochigi Prefecture Tochigi) – A Shikinaisha of Tsuga district in Shimotsuke Province.
* Ōmiwa Shrine (Ōtawara) (Tochigi Prefecture, Ōtawara)

==Chūbu Region==
* Ōmiwa Shrine (Ichinomiya) (Aichi Prefecture Ichinomiya, Aichi Hanaike) – A Shikinaisha of Nakashima district in Owari Province, possibly considered the Ichinomiya of Owari.
* Ōmiwa Shrine (Ichinomiya, Yamatocho Oho) (Ichinomiya, Aichi, Yamatocho Oho)
* Ōmiwa Shrine (Ichinomiya, Yamatocho Miyaji) (Ichinomiya, Aichi, Yamatocho Miyaji)
* Oomiwa Shrine (Gifu Prefecture Ōgaki) – A Shikinaisha in Tagi district in Mino Province.
* Ōmiwa Shrine (Ikeda, Gifu) (Gifu Prefecture, Q1206815, Ibi District, Gifu)
* Ōmiwa Shrine (Iga) (Mie Prefecture Iga, Mie)
* Q11371507 (Shizuoka Prefecture Kosai, Shizuoka) – Identified with an Ōmiwa Shrine.

==Kinki Region==
* Ōmiwa Shrine (Nagahama) (Shiga Prefecture Nagahama)
* Ōmiwa Shrine (Sakurai, Nara, Nara Prefecture) – A Shikinaisha of Shikijō district in Yamato Province (Myōjin Taisha), historically known as "Ōmiwa Ōmononushi Jinja," a former Modern system of Ranked Shinto Shrines.
* Ōmiwa Shrine (Yamatokoriyama) (Nara Prefecture, Yamatokoriyama)
* Ōmiwa Shrine (Nara City) (Nara Prefecture, Nara)
* Daijingūsha (Minamiyamashiro, Kyoto Prefecture)

==Chūgoku Region==
* Ōga Shrine (Okayama Naka-ku, Okayama, Okayama Prefecture) – A Shikinaisha in Jōtō district in Bizen Province.

==Kyushu Region==
* Ōmiwa Shrine (Takami-dai, Fukuoka) (Fukuoka Higashi-ku, Fukuoka Takami-dai)
* Ōmiwa Shrine (Wajirogaoka, Fukuoka) (Fukuoka City, Higashi-ku, Wajirogaoka)
